_comment: DA Registry staff API. Copy the keys you need into sites/<your-site>/site_config.json. Never commit a real client_secret.
_comment_auth: Whose token reaches the registry. user: the signed-in user's own staff IAM access token (Authorization: Bearer) and CSRF value (X-CSRF-Token), forwarded by DA Services after its RBAC check; da_registry_keycloak is not needed. service: the da-services-backend service account below. The scheduled registry read-back only runs with service.
_comment_master_data: Optional. Labels for the coded profile fields (Mr, Degree, Development agent) come from Master Data with the same token; without it codes are shown as words.
_comment_keycloak: Service account da-services-backend in realm staff (client credentials). Needs the client role Data Editor on da-registry-staff-portal to read DAs and open change requests. It cannot approve: approvals happen in the registry.
_comment_staff_login: Dev testing only, until the service account exists: replace da_registry_keycloak with a staff user that holds only Data Editor, e.g. {"login_url": "https://da-registry.development.oanstaging.com/api/login", "username": "da-services-dev", "password": "replace-me"}. Never use a person's account or this mode on staging or production.
_comment_local: Against the da-registry local stack from inside the frappe_docker container, use http://host.docker.internal:8101 for the base URL and http://host.docker.internal:8090/realms/staff/protocol/openid-connect/token for the token URL.
_comment_mock: Keep da_registry_backend as mock (the default) for tests and for sites without registry credentials.
